messages:
rhea: Need a compact decision for private deploy defaults so RFC can land. Quick votes: default networking mode, upgrade strategy, telemetry opt-in.

noah: Default = operator bundle + relay fallback. Lowest friction.

siti: Agree. Offer NAT/static egress for customers who need preserved outbound IPs. BGP = advanced, SE-assisted.

ben: Upgrades: default rolling canary (configurable percent/window). Auto-abort on smoke failures. Blue/green only as documented pattern.

rhea: Telemetry: default OFF for private deploys. Add `redwoodctl telemetry consent --scopes=errors,perf` -> produces audit token.

noah: Preflight must check firewall, MTU, nftables vs iptables, and detect legacy LB SNATs. `--preflight-only --output=json` mandatory for automation.

siti: Field ask: include a one-line maintenance window in comms: "Typical rolling upgrades: 15-60m; network cutovers may need coordination."

ben: Action items: Noah -> preflight checklist + `redwoodctl` flag spec (Tue), Siti -> SE migration pack sketch for BGP (Wed), Rhea -> assemble RFC (Fri).

deploy-bot: Created ticket PD-55021 "private-deploy defaults & rollout" assigned to @rhea @noah @siti @ben.
thread_text_summary: Short coordination: operator+relay default, NAT for egress, BGP as advanced/SE-assisted; rolling canary upgrades with auto-abort; telemetry default OFF; preflight checks and action owners assigned
